candidate: Per-tensor-count-matched learned versus random masks at E32, 50-65%
status: Recommended: finish a bounded descriptive analysis; no new compute warranted
research_question: At fixed 2500/2500 source/recovery attempts, do learned expert-local magnitude masks outperform a random mask with the same retained count in every named weight tensor at R0 and R100?
verified_motivation: Recomputed from 40 complete matched pairs: learned endpoint CE is lower than random in all 5 seeds in each of 8 sparsity-age strata. Mean learned-minus-random nats/token by .50/.55/.60/.65 is (-.0682,-.0608,-.0714,-.0803) at R0 and (-.0590,-.0676,-.0822,-.0927) at R100. Absolute/gap means show learned is usually still worse than its matched dense reference; see verified_observations.csv.
strongest_counterevidence: Same validation used to select masks; one random draw per seed/sparsity; only five already-used seeds; randomization fixes tensor allocation rather than testing allocation; router-induced accepted exposure differs; no untouched test split. These 40 cells are repeated within five source seeds, not n=40 independent replications.
assets_reused: 100 completed sparse recoveries (60 learned/40 random), 15 reused dense recoveries, per-attempt metadata, validation curves, exact masks and hashes.
missing_controls: Fresh independent seeds, multiple random masks per source/sparsity, and held-out evaluation with proven split provenance would be needed for a confirmatory claim; none is available now.
smallest_next_step: Publish the 40-pair table with seed as unit, all eight strata retained, endpoint CE primary, matched dense absolute CE/gaps shown separately; no metric search or claim of test generalization.
compute_class: No training/recovery; CPU-only audit already completed.
run_count_and_resource_basis: 0 new model runs; 115 manifest artifacts rechecked; 40 pairs joined by seed/sparsity/age; no weights loaded or forwards run. A hypothetical fresh confirmation is at least 55 jobs (5 fresh sources + 50 recoveries, 137,500 attempted updates); a rough 7-10 GPU-hour estimate from one observed 451-second E32/2500 recovery is highly uncertain and excludes validated held-out-data preparation.
prospective_stopping_rule: Prospective only: if reopened, preregister the four sparsity-age strata and one endpoint; on genuinely held-out data and fresh seeds, require the paired effect to favor learned masks in each stratum with simultaneous uncertainty intervals excluding zero; otherwise stop or narrow the claim. No threshold is applied to the retrospective result.
prior_work_and_potential_contribution: Frankle & Carbin's Lottery Ticket Hypothesis makes learned-versus-random a standard control, so this is not a novelty claim. A narrow MoE contribution is exact tensor-count matching across expert-local masks and router-age conditions; novelty unresolved.
why_answer_matters: It answers whether the most expensive existing lower-grid mask-selection compute produced coordinate-level value beyond random selection, without confounding that result with tensor allocation.

candidate: Router-age winner reliability across architecture and sparsity
status: Already descriptively answered; do not add seeds now
research_question: Does the mean validation-optimal source-router age generalize to the five individual source seeds across the 8-32E, 70-95% Dataset A grid?
verified_motivation: All 30 five-seed curves are complete. Mean winners are intermediate in 16, R0 in 10, and R100 in 4; all five seed-wise winner sets include the mean winner in only 1/30 curves. At 95%, every architecture's mean winner is R0.
strongest_counterevidence: Age winners are selected from the same validation surface; five seeds are modest; architecture-specific results do not establish a universal age; source exposure and maturity are not matched across E.
assets_reused: The 1650 sparse and 275 dense Dataset A recoveries, plus full 50-step curves, manifests and seed-winner tables.
missing_controls: Fresh seeds and held-out evaluation for transportability; accepted exposure/convergence-matched architecture controls for a developmental mechanism.
smallest_next_step: Use existing table as a negative/descriptive result; no search over alternative winner rules.
compute_class: No new compute for existing description; new-source confirmation would be required for external generalization.
run_count_and_resource_basis: 0 now. A fresh 5-seed replication across all 5 architectures, 6 sparsities, 11 ages would be 1650 sparse + 275 dense recoveries and is not justified by current evidence.
prospective_stopping_rule: Prospective only: any future confirmatory age must be fixed before evaluation; test a single predeclared age contrast on fresh seeds and held-out validation, with no per-cell winner selection. Stop if the directional effect fails in the predeclared architecture strata.
prior_work_and_potential_contribution: Age-conditioned early rewind is related to LTH/rewinding; no novelty inferred from an optimum scan. The useful contribution is the demonstrated instability of selected optima under existing seeds.
why_answer_matters: Prevents costly architecture-wide age searches from being justified by visually nonmonotonic, seed-specific minima.

strongest_counterevidence: Sequentially completed arms create selection bias; source budget also changes source model, router age, and selected mask; AdamW/scaler/RNG are reset rather than exact continuation; attempts differ from applied updates; full source exposure has limitations.
assets_reused: Partial A/C artifacts, existing Dataset A references, exposure logs, masks, per-attempt updates, and resource estimates.
missing_controls: Complete B/D and long sources; final matching/availability checks; replicate beyond five reused seeds if confirmatory; held-out evaluation if generalization is claimed.
smallest_next_step: Do a no-training inventory/status audit only. Do not use partial arm means as factorial evidence.
compute_class: Current next step no training; full factorial completion would require the remaining registered jobs and source runs.

candidate: IMP versus one-shot masks or fc1/fc2 capacity allocation
status: Rejected for now: incompatible assets and no verified motivating effect
research_question: Does iterative nested pruning beat one-shot expert-local magnitude pruning or an explicit per-expert fc1/fc2 capacity-allocation baseline at equal masks, data, and recovery budgets?
verified_motivation: Prepared 80/85% IMP pipeline exists, and one distinct legacy 8E representative IMP result underperformed one-shot/rewind. No matched current cohort compares IMP against capacity-allocation controls.
strongest_counterevidence: The new IMP grid is not run; OMP and IMP differ in discovery cost, mask state, rewind, and optimizer protocol. The legacy IMP cell is a different dataset/model/budget. Existing masks do not provide the counterfactual training baseline.
assets_reused: One-shot masks and recoveries across E8-32; preflighted but unlaunched IMP implementation; many source and checkpoint assets.
missing_controls: Same source seeds, architecture, data, mask sparsity, total attempted/applied budget and matched dense controls; explicit allocation baseline; new IMP discovery/recovery compute.
smallest_next_step: No computation now; first define a same-budget estimand before considering a training design.
compute_class: Would require IMP discovery plus recoveries and a new allocation arm; not a lightweight extension.
run_count_and_resource_basis: No run plan recommended. Prepared IMP alone projects 225 discovery stages + 50 recoveries (687,500 attempts; provisional ~670+ GPU-hours) for E8/16/32 seeds7/17 and .80/.85, before the missing matched allocation control.
prospective_stopping_rule: Prospective only: compare one fixed sparsity and architecture first; stop if both IMP and allocation baseline fail to improve a predeclared held-out endpoint under equal total compute; do not expand the grid after a selected win.
prior_work_and_potential_contribution: Iterative pruning and capacity allocation are established pruning comparisons; current evidence does not establish a MoE-specific gap or novelty.
why_answer_matters: Would distinguish a substantive algorithmic advantage from simply allocating more surviving parameters to high-capacity expert matrices, but present runs cannot answer it.
